name: Jo Siffert
features: dark swept-back hair, thick dark moustache, deep-set eyes, lean wiry build, easy grin
bio: A Fribourg garage hand who bought his way into racing with a second-hand Cooper and became Porsche's most trusted long-distance driver. He and Brian Redman were the Gulf-Wyer pairing everyone else measured themselves against in 1970: pole almost everywhere, fastest lap almost everywhere, and a habit of driving the 917 as if the race were a sprint.
